what: Diagnosis of the v1 (el_full) lexical-search slowdown seen during v1check (about 22 s per query, against 4.7 s p50 retrieval in bench_el_pg)
script: one-off EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) of mahabodi_pg.search's lex CTE, the first 3 test mentions, each run twice (the first run's reads warm the cache for the second)
plan: Bitmap Index Scan on atf_p10_tsv_idx -> Bitmap Heap Scan on atf_p10 (unchanged from v1)
finding: No index dropped or changed, no bloat, statistics current. The slowdown is cold-cache I/O: a common mention reads ~70K heap blocks from disk (11.3 s) and takes 0.17 s warm. v1's hot set (11 GB HNSW + 3.9 GB tsv GIN + heap) exceeds the 16 GB machine now that the v2 store database is also cached. Predictions are unaffected; v1-corner latency depends on cache state and is not comparable across runs unless warmed the same way.
